items.information: Valor das inscrições será de R$ 5,00 a serem pagos no dia do campeonato. O evento é aberto a qualquer pessoa de qualquer nacionalidade. Haverá registro no dia do campeonato (se o limite máximo de competidores não for alcançado anteriormente) e custará R$ 8,00. ________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Registration fee will be R$ 5,00 to be paid on the day of the competition. items.information: 関西定例大会夏2019内の3×3×3第一ラウンドで、年齢別「こども大会」（小学生以下）および「マスターズ大会」（35歳以上）を併催します。 対象年齢内での順位を決め、第一ラウンド終了後に表彰を行います(WCA上の入賞とは異なります)。 第一ラウンドで「こども大会」「マスターズ大会」に参加していても、全年齢含めての順位が上位であればそのまま第二ラウンドに進むことができます。 During the first round of 3x3x3 at the Kansai Summer 2019, we will also hold an age-specific “Juniors Competition” (competitors less than primary school children) and "Masters Competition" (competitors of 35 years of age or older). At the end of this first round, the rankings for each age category will be determined, and awards will be given. These awards are separated from the actual WCA competition. Even if you join the “Juniors Competition” or the “Masters Competiton” in the first round, you can continue to the second round if your ranking within all participants allows it.
